statement: The generic bitangent Galois group of a smooth plane quartic is W(E7)/{±1}≅Sp6(F2), of order 1,451,520.
scope: The 28 bitangents of a general plane quartic and their coefficient splitting field.
notes:
The full group is generic; special rational quartics can have smaller splitting-field groups. This established classical group is substantively used and represented, rather than claimed as a new discovery here.

The displayed pair is copied from primary database construction data, with its stated order 1451520. The default verifier checks exact transcription and transitivity; --full also enumerates the group.

Generator source: https://www.lmfdb.org/Groups/Abstract/1451520.a — Construction of abstract group, Sage/GAP permutation generators.

LMFDB identification: 28T1256 in the recorded permutation degree. Standard generating permutations, when newly supplied here, are an abstract relabeling of the proved group action; they are not additional path-tracking data. LMFDB abstract group 1451520.a lists 28T1256 as its degree-28 realization.

Source discussion. The generic bitangent Galois group is W(E7)/{±1}≅Sp6(F2), of order 1,451,520; the paper describes its action through Cayley octads and Cremona transformations.
